lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized 2D grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the five gill slits, forming approximately six vertical columns and four horizontal rows of varying intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like alignment particularly visible in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient, with light-toned dorsal surfaces transitioning to shadowed ventral troughs.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-intensity circular blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, which is oriented toward the top-left background of the frame.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-contrast silhouettes representing commensal organisms (remoras) attached to or swimming near the pectoral and ventral regions.
